section.content: The present invention provides a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit and includes the semiconductor system of semiconductor integrated circuit.Described semiconductor integrated circuit includes: multiple semiconductor chips, and the plurality of semiconductor chip is chosen respectively in response to multiple chip select signals；And chip select signal generator, described chip select signal generator is configured to respond to first control signal for deciding whether driving semiconductor chip and for selecting at least one second control signal of at least one semiconductor chip from semiconductor chip, produces chip select signal.
本发明提供种半导体集成电路和包括半导体集成电路的半导体系统。所述半导体集成电路包括：多个半导体芯片，所述多个半导体芯片响应于多个芯片选择信号而分别被选择；以及芯片选择信号发生器，所述芯片选择信号发生器被配置为响应于用于决定是否驱动半导体芯片的个第控制信号和用于从半导体芯片中选择至少个半导体芯片的至少个第二控制信号，来产生芯片选择信号。

Semiconductor integrated circuit and the semiconductor system including semiconductor integrated circuitCross-Reference to Related Applications

This application claims the priority of the korean patent application No.10-2011-0028780 submitted on March 30th, 2011, entire contents is incorporated in herein by quoting.

Technical field

The exemplary embodiment of the present invention relates to a kind of quasiconductor design, more specifically, relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit and includes the semiconductor system of this semiconductor integrated circuit.

Background technology

In this description, the technology of the present invention is described as a example by semiconductor storage unit.

Generally, the semiconductor storage unit of such as dynamic random access memory (DRAM) by stacking and encapsulates multiple semiconductor chip or nude film and manufactures, in order to obtained bigger capacity with identical area more in the past.Here, stacking also encapsulates the semiconductor storage unit of a semiconductor chip and is referred to as single nude film encapsulation (SDP), and stacking encapsulate the semiconductor storage unit of two semiconductor chips and be referred to as double nude film encapsulation (DDP).Stacking also encapsulates the semiconductor storage unit of four semiconductor chips and is referred to as four nude films encapsulation (QDP).

Meanwhile, control whether to drive semiconductor chip that is stacked and that encapsulate to the chip select signal that each semiconductor chip applies based on being externally controlled device.

Figure 1A illustrates the semiconductor system including single nude film encapsulation according to prior art, and Figure 1B illustrates the semiconductor system including double nude film encapsulation according to prior art.Fig. 1 C illustrates the semiconductor system including four nude film encapsulation according to prior art.

Seeing Figure 1A, semiconductor system 10 includes the first peripheral control unit 11 and first to fourth single nude film encapsulation 13,15,17 and 19.First peripheral control unit 11 produces first to fourth chip select signal CS0#, CS1#, CS2# and CS3#.Meanwhile, first to fourth single nude film encapsulation 13,15,17 and 19 each with semiconductor chip (not shown) is driven respectively responsive to first to fourth chip select signal CS0#, CS1#, CS2# and CS3#.

Here, the first peripheral control unit 11 is driven by which being applied independently that first to fourth chip select signal CS0#, CS1#, CS2# and CS3# come in semiconductor chip included in independently controlled first to fourth single nude film encapsulation 13,15,17 and 19 via first to fourth channel C S_CH#0, CS_CH#1, CS_CH#2 and CS_CH#3 respectively.Typically, first to fourth chip select signal CS0#, CS1#, CS2# and CS3# is low level activation signal.

First to fourth single nude film encapsulation 13,15,17 and 19 each includes a pad CS_PIN0 for receiving first to fourth chip select signal CS0#, CS1#, CS2# and CS3# respectively.Owing to first to fourth single nude film encapsulates under 13,15,17 and 19 controls being in the first peripheral control unit 11, therefore various signals are sent to the first peripheral control unit 11/ and receive various signal from the first peripheral control unit 11 by first to fourth single nude film encapsulation 13,15,17 and 19.Such as, each included semiconductor chip in first to fourth single nude film encapsulation 13,15,17 and 19 is driven according to corresponding chip select signal CS0#, CS1#, CS2# or CS3#, and perform for storing the write operation applying the data (not shown) come from the first peripheral control unit 11 in response to the order come from the first peripheral control unit 11 transmission and address (not shown), or execution for being supplied to the read operation of the first peripheral control unit 11 by the data (not shown) of storage.

Seeing Figure 1B, semiconductor system 20 includes 21, first pair of nude film encapsulation the 23 and the 2nd 4 nude film encapsulation 25 of the second peripheral control unit.Second peripheral control unit 21 produces first to fourth chip select signal CS0#, CS1#, CS2# and CS3#.First pair of nude film encapsulates 23 and drives two wherein included semiconductor chip (not shown) in response to the first and second chip select signal CS0# and CS1# independently.Equally, second pair of nude film encapsulates 25 and drives two wherein included semiconductor chip (not shown) in response to the third and fourth chip select signal CS2# and CS3# independently.

Here, as the first peripheral control unit 11 as shown in Figure 1A, the second peripheral control unit 21 carrys out independently controlled each two the included semiconductor chips whether driven in first and second pairs of nude film encapsulation 23 and 25 by first to fourth chip select signal CS0#, CS1#, CS2# and CS3# being applied independently via first to fourth channel C S_CH#0, CS_CH#1, CS_CH#2 and CS_CH#3.

And, first and second pairs of nude film encapsulation 23 and 25 each include two pad CS_PIN0 and CS_PIN1 for receiving two chip select signal CS0# and CS1# or CS2# and CS3# respectively.Simultaneously as first and second pairs of nude films encapsulate under 23 and 25 controls being in the second peripheral control unit 21, therefore various signals are sent to the second peripheral control unit 21/ and receive various signal from the second peripheral control unit 21 by first and second pairs of nude film encapsulation 23 and 25.Such as, in first pair of nude film encapsulation 23 and second pair of nude film encapsulation 25, each two included semiconductor chips select signal to be driven based on the respective chip in first to fourth chip select signal CS0#, CS1#, CS2# and CS3#, and semiconductor chip performs for storing the write operation applying the data (not shown) come from the second peripheral control unit 21 in response to the order come from the second peripheral control unit 21 transmission and address (not shown), or execution for being supplied to the read operation of the second peripheral control unit 21 by the data (not shown) of storage.

See Fig. 1 C, semiconductor system 30 includes the 3rd peripheral control unit 31 for producing first to fourth chip select signal CS0#, CS1#, CS2# and CS3#, and drives four nude film encapsulation 33 of four wherein included semiconductor chip (not shown) independently in response to first to fourth chip select signal CS0#, CS1#, CS2# and CS3#.

Here, as the first peripheral control unit 11 as shown in Figure 1A, the 3rd peripheral control unit 31 carrys out four semiconductor chips included by independently controlled whether driving in four nude film encapsulation 33 by first to fourth chip select signal CS0#, CS1#, CS2# and CS3# being applied independently via first to fourth channel C S_CH#0, CS_CH#1, CS_CH#2 and CS_CH#3.

And, four nude film encapsulation 33 also include four pads CS_PIN0, CS_PIN1, CS_PIN2 and CS_PIN3 for receiving first to fourth chip select signal CS0#, CS1#, CS2# and CS3#.Simultaneously as four nude film encapsulation 33 are under the control of the 3rd peripheral control unit 31, therefore various signals are sent to the 3rd peripheral control unit 31/ and receive various signal from the 3rd peripheral control unit 31 by four nude film encapsulation 33.Such as, in four nude film encapsulation 33, four included semiconductor chips are driven based on corresponding chip select signal CS0#, CS1#, CS2# and CS3#, and perform for storing the write operation applying the data (not shown) come from the 3rd peripheral control unit 31 in response to the order come from the 3rd peripheral control unit 31 transmission and address (not shown), or execution for being supplied to the read operation of the 3rd peripheral control unit 31 by the data (not shown) of storage.

The known semiconductor system 10,20 and 30 with above structure has the disadvantage that.

First, it is used for the number of channels applying chip select signal to increase along with the increase of semiconductor chip quantity included in system.Such as, the first peripheral control unit 11 needs first passage CS_CH#0 to control first single nude film encapsulation 13, and the second peripheral control unit 21 needs the first and second signal CS_CH#0 and CS_CH#1 to control first pair of nude film encapsulation 23.3rd peripheral control unit 31 needs first to fourth channel C S_CH#0, CS_CH#1, CS_CH#2 and CS_CH#3 to control four nude film encapsulation 33.Correspondingly, when stacking when encapsulating 8,16 or 32 semiconductor chips in semiconductor packages, peripheral control unit needs and the as many passage of semiconductor chip quantity.In view of the increase of the integrated level of semiconductor device, the increase on number of channels is significantly to limit.

Additionally, semiconductor packages 13,15,17,19,23,25 and 33 needs and the as many pad of semiconductor chip quantity included in it.Such as, first single nude film encapsulation 13 includes a pad CS_PIN0 for receiving the first chip select signal CS0#, and first pair of nude film encapsulation 23 includes two pad CS_PIN0 and CS_PIN1 for receiving the first and second chip select signal CS0# and CS1#.Four nude film encapsulation 33 include four pads CS_PIN0, CS_PIN1, CS_PIN2 and CS_PIN3 for receiving first to fourth chip select signal CS0#, CS1#, CS2# and CS3#.When stacking and when encapsulating 8,16 or 32 semiconductor chips, to there is pad as many with semiconductor chip quantity.But, along with stacking and the progress of encapsulation technology, i.e. along with stacking the increase of semiconductor chip quantity that encapsulates, the increase of number of pads is inevitable.Accordingly, it would be desirable to the problem that a kind of method solves to increase for the area of pad.

Summary of the invention

The exemplary embodiment of the present invention is for a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, and it has the pad for receiving chip select signal reducing quantity.

Other exemplary embodiment of the present invention is for a kind of semiconductor system, and in described semiconductor system, the area being externally controlled the semiconductor integrated circuit that device controls reduces, and the number of channels of peripheral control unit also reduces simultaneously.

According in one exemplary embodiment of the present invention, a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit includes: multiple semiconductor chips, the plurality of semiconductor chip is chosen respectively in response to multiple chip select signals；And chip select signal generator, described chip select signal generator is configured to respond to first control signal for deciding whether driving semiconductor chip and for selecting at least one second control signal of at least one semiconductor chip from semiconductor chip, produces chip select signal.

Semiconductor integrated circuit can also include that multiple pad, the plurality of pad are configured to receive the first control signal and at least one second control signal described.The quantity of pad can be less than or equal to the quantity of semiconductor chip.

According to another exemplary embodiment of the present invention, a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit includes: multiple semiconductor chips, the plurality of semiconductor chip is chosen respectively in response to multiple chip select signals；And chip select signal generator, described chip select signal generator is configured to respond at least one first control signal for deciding whether driving semiconductor chip and for selecting second control signal of at least one semiconductor chip from semiconductor chip, produces chip select signal.

Semiconductor integrated circuit can also include that multiple pad, the plurality of pad are configured to receive the second control signal and at least one first control signal described.The quantity of pad can be less than or equal to the quantity of semiconductor chip.

Another exemplary embodiment according to the present invention, a kind of semiconductor system includes: controller, and described controller is configured to produce multiple first control signals for controlling whether driving semiconductor chip and for controlling to select at least one second control signal of which semiconductor chip；And multiple semiconductor integrated circuit, each in the plurality of semiconductor integrated circuit includes multiple semiconductor chip and is configured to respond at least one second control signal described and first control signal corresponding with the semiconductor chip chosen in the plurality of first control signal, selects at least one semiconductor chip from semiconductor chip.

Each in semiconductor integrated circuit can also include: the first pad, and described first pad is for receiving first control signal corresponding with the semiconductor chip chosen among the plurality of first control signal；And at least one second pad, at least one second pad described is used for receiving at least one second control signal described.

Another exemplary embodiment according to the present invention, a kind of semiconductor system includes: controller, and described controller is configured to produce at least one first control signal for controlling whether driving semiconductor chip and for controlling to select at least one second control signal of which semiconductor chip；And semiconductor integrated circuit, described semiconductor integrated circuit includes multiple semiconductor chip, and is configured to respond at least one first control signal described and at least one second control signal described and selects at least one semiconductor chip from semiconductor chip.

Additionally, semiconductor integrated circuit can also include: at least one first pad, at least one first pad described is used for receiving at least one first control signal described；And at least one second pad, at least one second pad described is used for receiving at least one second control signal described.

Detailed description of the invention

It is described more fully the exemplary embodiment of the present invention below with reference to accompanying drawings.But, the present invention can implement by different modes, and should not be construed as limited to embodiments set forth herein.Exactly, it is provided that these embodiments are to make this specification understand and completely, and will pass on the scope of the present invention completely to those skilled in the art.In this manual, identical reference represents identical parts in each drawings and Examples of the present invention.

In this article, by stacking and be packaged with multiple semiconductor chip and be referred to as semiconductor packages with the semiconductor integrated circuit with three-dimensional (3D) package-on-package structure.

Additionally, in this article, in case of two semiconductor packages to be provided it should be appreciated that any amount of semiconductor packages can be provided.

Fig. 2 is the block diagram that the semiconductor system according to the first exemplary embodiment of the present invention is described.

Seeing Fig. 2, semiconductor system 100 includes peripheral control unit the 110, first semiconductor packages 120 and the second semiconductor packages 130.Peripheral control unit 110 produces the first chip driving control signals CS0# and the second chip driving control signals CS1# for controlling whether to drive semiconductor chip, and produces for controlling whether that the common chip selecting semiconductor chip selects control signal KA0.First semiconductor packages 120 includes two semiconductor chips.Control signal KA0 can be selected to select any one in the two semiconductor chip in response to the first chip driving control signals CS0# and common chip.Similarly, the second semiconductor packages 130 includes two semiconductor chips, control signal KA0 can be selected to select any one in the two semiconductor chip in response to the second chip driving control signals CS1# and common chip.As it has been described above, be that each semiconductor packages (such as, the first semiconductor packages 120 and the second semiconductor packages 130) provides corresponding chip driving control signals (such as, CS0# and CS1#).

Here, peripheral control unit 110 exports the first chip driving control signals CS0#, the second chip driving control signals CS1# via independent channel C S_CH0, CS_CH1 and CS_CH2 respectively and common chip selects control signal KA0.Coded method can be utilized to produce the first chip driving control signals CS0#, the second chip driving control signals CS1# for peripheral control unit 110 and common chip selects control signal KA0.In other words, the first chip driving control signals CS0#, the second chip driving control signals CS1# and common chip select control signal KA0 can be encoded signal.

First semiconductor packages 120 and the second semiconductor packages 130 are double nude films encapsulation (DDP), and each encapsulation in described pair of nude film encapsulation includes stacking two semiconductor chips encapsulated.Therefore, the first semiconductor packages 120 and the second semiconductor packages 130 each have 2 storages row (rank).Quantity based on the storage row in each semiconductor packages, it may be determined that the quantity of the pad in each semiconductor packages.Relation between quantity and the quantity of pad of storage row is represented by below equation 1.

Equation 1: the quantity of pad=(log2x)+1, wherein " x " is the quantity storing row of semiconductor packages.

As in figure 2 it is shown, the first semiconductor packages 120 and the second semiconductor packages 130 each include two pad CS_PIN0 and CS_PIN1.In the first semiconductor packages 120, use two pad CS_PIN0 and CS_PIN1 to receive the first chip driving control signals CS0# and common chip selects control signal KA0.It addition, in the second semiconductor packages 130, use two pad CS_PIN0 and CS_PIN1 to receive the second chip driving control signals CS1# and common chip select control signal KA0.Therefore, first semiconductor packages 120 can read the first chip driving control signals CS0# and common chip based on interpretation method and select control signal KA0, to produce interiorization signal and to use described interiorization signal as the first chip select signal LRA_CS0B and the second chip select signal LRA_CS1B.Similarly, second semiconductor packages 130 can read the second chip driving control signals CS1# and common chip based on interpretation method and select control signal KA0, to produce for selecting himself the interiorization signal any one in two semiconductor chips therein.
